turn_text: This is Derek Miller speaking on business. The Utah Aerospace and Defense Association recently announced former Congressman Chris Stewart as their new chair. He will help the organization continue to build the world's premier aerospace and defense ecosystem in Utah. Former Congressman Chris Stewart tells us more.

Utah Aerospace and Defense Association is charting an ambitious course for our state to build the world's premier ecosystem for aerospace and defense companies here in Utah. We convene advocate and promote companies that are developing next generation technologies to keep our nation safe and Utah's economy strong. Utah is home to the world's largest small satellite conference that draws thousands of leading researchers from all around the world. A Utah company recently developed the technology astronauts rely on for oxygen and space. As a former world record-setting Air Force pilot, I understand the importance of our state's military to the quality of life here. Hill Air Force Base alone generates more than $7 billion annually and employs nearly 40,000 people. We believe the future of Utah's economy will be shaped by this critical industry. So we're making efforts to recruit talent, source capital, and create an ecosystem that enables entrepreneurs to flourish.
